newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes down in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed down by 0.34 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 478.52 points, down from 480.13 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 967,146 dinars against 7.73 million dinars over the previous session.
Societe Tunisienne de l'Industrie Laitiere fell 1.92 dinar to 7.08 dinars.
Arab Tunisian Bank was down 0.88 dinar to 28.72.
Retail stores Monoprix slid 0.58 dinar to 32.2 dinars. Monoprix announced that it had started distributing 1.2 dinar dividend on its 1996 results.
Detergents firm SPCD edged lower 0.48 dinar to 35 dinars. Palm Beach Hotels eased 0.21 dinar to 10.77.
Banque de l'Habitat declined 0.12 dinar to 16.04 dinars. UIB bank was down 0.12 dinar to 11.84.
Societe Tunisienne de Banque was up 0.46 dinar to 15.97 dinars. UBCI bank rose 0.3 dinar to 45.9. BTEI bank advanced 0.1 dinar to 22.4 dinars. ($1=1.0957 dinar)
